messages:
Noah (ML): Quick sync — new model bring-up (redwood-q4b-experimental) shows concentrated failures on a smallholdout of long-code prompts from promptset_v10. ~6.9% drop vs float baseline on our golden slice. Looking for fast triage and label handoff.
Gita (Ops): what did you run and which slice?
Noah (ML): run: `./eval/run_eval --model=redwood-q4b-experimental --prompts=promptset_v10_longcode.json --gold=gold_v6.json --metrics=exact_match,bleu --bs=4` Failures cluster on multi-file examples and multi-step instruction summaries. Attached ids_longcode.csv (22 ids).
Kei (DevEx): i can do a dedupe and sampler pass. plan: 1) sparsehash dedupe @0.83, 2) stratify by num_files and prompt_tokens, 3) sample 40 items for pairwise labeling (float vs q4). Command: `python tools/sparse_dedupe.py --t=0.83 --stratify=num_files,prompt_tokens --keep=longer`
Noah (ML): label schema: ACCEPT / PARTIAL / REJECT. PARTIAL needs 1-line note and a tag if it's a tokenization/deid issue (tag: token-artefact). If REJECT >12% escalate to runtime/model team. Baseline float had 2.7% PARTIAL/REJECT.
Gita (Ops): reserving ephemeral GPU slot tomorrow 07:00 PST (/gpu/ephemeral-03) for devex smoke runs. INF ticket INF-2026-399 created. link: https://infra/runs/ephemeral-03-longcode
LabelerBot: Assigned label batch LB-2026-04-15-09 -> Kei, 40 examples, est 6h.
Kei (DevEx): i'll run a quick kernel-compat smoke as well: `export REDWOOD_KERNEL_MODE=compat` and `--kv-cache=off` to isolate kv cache interaction. If compat fixes majority, we'll pin kernel selection and file a runtime bug.
Noah (ML): please include `--trace-kv` in the smoke to tag any token-level kv misses. add a kv-flag to examples during labeling if trace shows mismatch.
Kei (DevEx): dedupe done, posting sample ids and the short Google form link for labelers. Pausing labels for ids where compat run resolves the mismatch to avoid wasted work.
LabelerBot: status -> in_progress (10/40 labeled). Kei: reminder ping.
Gita (Ops): infra smoke started and KV traces uploaded to run link.
Noah (ML): thanks — once labels are back, please update golden changelog with `q4-longcode-2026-04-15` and mark confirmed failures to golden-supplement if REJECT/PARTIAL with missing steps. I'll draft triage doc with trace correlation and proposed kernel pin if needed.
Kei (DevEx): noted. resuming labeling after 20m hold for compat check.
